title: GHMC-RADS — Rainfall Analytics and Decision Support Platform
summary: Real-time rainfall monitoring and decision support for urban flood management in Hyderabad, joining rainfall observations to meteorological and geospatial data for emergency response, stormwater management and operational planning.

title: AISwARYAM — AI for Sustainable Infrastructure and Resource Planning, Analysis and Monitoring
funder: IndiaAI Mission, Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
summary: An IIT Hyderabad initiative under the Government of India's IndiaAI Mission, guided by the vision of making AI in India and making AI work for India.

title: CGodvari — Centre for Godavari river basin management and studies
funder: Ministry of Jal Shakti, Government of India
summary: A centre for management and studies of the Godavari river basin.

title: DRSTI — Dynamic range estimation and simulation of tides with immersive visualisation
Real-time 2D flood inundation forecasting for the Brahmaputra River basin
role: Leads the project at IIT Hyderabad
partners: A collaboration with four other institutes
summary: Hydrologic, hydrodynamic and statistical-dynamical approaches to real-time two-dimensional flood inundation forecasting.

title: Samvad in the Godavari — mentoring students along the Godavari basin
summary: Mentoring disenfranchised higher education and university students along the Godavari basin in Telangana.

title: Urban flood modelling — a web-based decision tool integrating UAV information
An experimental operational hydrologic modelling and forecasting system for river basin hydrology and extremes for India
role: Led the project at IIT Hyderabad

title: Climate extremes, societal resiliency and the Krishna River Basin
funder: Asia-Pacific Network for Global Change Research
partners: With Jenderal Soedirman University, Jawa Tengah, Indonesia
role: Leads the project at IIT Hyderabad
summary: Understanding space-time variability of climate extremes for societal resiliency in Indonesia and India. A focus group discussion workshop for the Krishna basin was held in January 2020.
